defaultPrompt: Review this workspace for DORA evidence gaps and report the Review Priority.
Can you produce your ICT third-party evidence today?
What DORA evidence is not observed, and what should I review next?
interface.longDescription: DORA has applied since 17 January 2025. Review whether a workspace holds the ICT third-party register, operational resilience policy, incident records, resilience testing evidence and contractual exit material that a regulator, auditor or customer typically asks for. A local, filename-and-path-only review that reports EVIDENCE OBSERVED / NOT OBSERVED, a deterministic Review Priority with its reasons, why each class matters and what to review next. It reviews evidence; it does not assess or certify compliance.

name: eczid-dora-readiness
